baselines.previous_race_order: The driver's literal result from their previous appearance, including exceptional results.
baselines.driver_form_unweighted: Mean of all earlier classified finishing scores.
baselines.driver_form_season_weighted: Mean of all earlier classified finishing scores using the configured season weights.
baselines.driver_form_recent_5: Mean of the five most recent classified finishing scores.
baselines.driver_form_recent_10: Mean of the ten most recent classified finishing scores.
baselines.constructor_teammate_unweighted: 70% constructor form and 30% teammate-adjusted driver form using all earlier races.
baselines.constructor_teammate_season_weighted: 70% constructor form and 30% teammate-adjusted driver form using season weights.
baselines.constructor_teammate_recent_5: 70% constructor form and 30% teammate-adjusted driver form from five recent values.
baselines.constructor_teammate_recent_10: 70% constructor form and 30% teammate-adjusted driver form from ten recent values.

new_constructor_fallback: Mean constructor score from earlier races, or 0.5.
primary_metric: Average Spearman rank correlation across held-out races.
